save_quantized_model_fp8: save a quantized model in FP8 format to an output directory with tokenizer and processor
pack_layer_fp8: pack a model layer for FP8 quantization by replacing it with a quantized FP8QLinear or FP8BlockQLinear module
create_fp8_qlinear: create an FP8QLinear module with weight scale and optional zero point for per-channel FP8 quantization
create_fp8_block_qlinear: create an FP8BlockQLinear module with inverse weight scale for per-block FP8 quantization
review_pack_layer: review the pack_layer function to understand how it handles weight quantization with group size and zero point
